variables.name: PACKAGE_VERSION
variables.description: Version of the package in semantic versioning

variables.name: PACKAGE_DESCRIPTION
variables.description: Description of the package, a free text
variables.value_example: A simple rqt plugin for controlling and monitoring the Profilobot

variables.name: PACKAGE_MAINTAINER_NAME
variables.description: Full name of the maintainer, first name in lower case, capitalized and last name in upper case

variables.name: PACKAGE_LICENSE
variables.description: License of the package, ideally one of ["Apache-2.0","BSL-1.0","BSD-2.0","BSD-2-Clause","BSD-3-Clause","GPL-3.0-only","LGPL-3.0-only","MIT","MIT-0"]

variables.name: CAMEL_CASE_PACKAGE_NAME
variables.description: Name of the package in camel case

variables.name: UNCAPITALIZED_CAMEL_CASE_PACKAGE_NAME
variables.description: Name of the package in camel case without the first letter capitalized

variables.name: OBJECT_HUMAN_NAME
variables.description: Human readable name of the object, in title case

variables.name: LABORATORY
variables.description: Name of the laboratory for copyright

variables.name: LICENSE_TEXT
variables.description: Text of the license, corresponding to one of the specified licenses

variables.name: UPPER_CASE_PACKAGE_NAME
variables.description: Name of the package in upper case

variables.name: LABEL_GROUP
variables.description: Label of the plugin in the rqt_gui

variables.name: ICON_GROUP
variables.description: Icon of the plugin in the rqt_gui

variables.name: STATUS_TIP_GROUP
variables.description: Status tip of the plugin in the rqt_gui
variables.value_example: Plugins related to the robot control related to RQT Profilobot UI.
variables.default: Plugins related to the robot control related to %(OBJECT_HUMAN_NAME)s

variables.name: LABEL
variables.description: Label of the plugin, usually the same as the object human name

variables.name: STATUS_TIP
variables.description: Status tip of the plugin, usually the same as the package name with underscores replaced by spaces
